book.name: Mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ
book.title: Ŋwa wu mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ Joŋ le

content: Mwa Shoŋ bwɛɛdɛ kila kì ajiŋ
Mwa Shoŋ gɛ̀ bwɛɛdɛ kila kì kiŋgane kinsooshwi a ŋwa wɛɛ le, manjuu chii fɛwe nɛ shiiŋŋ gɛɛŋ bu kiŋgade ki kife antɛnɛɛ.
Mɛ mo n'yɛŋ banchɛndaa ba Nyo ba bvusooshwi le bo to bo lɛme a Nyo fwe. Ba nya chisoŋ bvusooshwi bo le.

Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wumu ja wu to wu lɛɛŋ fɛ kitana ki kintanyɛ le, wu kɛme finlaŋ fì ba tone jiiŋ yo, ba kɛnyɛ bɛ kichwa ki bige kì yɛɛde. Ba nya jiiŋ wu le chi duude ki wu tâashɛ fɛ kitana ki kintanyɛ bɛ buunɛ chi bamii ba le ba Nyo le. Kitana kiyu ba kɛnyɛ bɛ kichwa ki bige kì yɛɛde, ki nyume a kala fwe.
Wu toŋ, chijige chi jiiŋ chiyu bɛ buunɛ chi bamii ba le ba Nyo, bu a wu bo chi bɛɛŋ chi gɛɛŋ a Nyo fwe.

Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wuyu mo wu ja wu jo finlaŋ fì ba tone jiiŋ yo fiɛɛ, wu jo ŋgu fɛ kitana ki kintanyɛ le, wu gɛɛ yo wu yisɛ, wu mo wu noŋ yi nshɛŋ le. No wu noŋ noo, jaŋ tu yi lale, yi ŋgbwame, yi kfuunɛ, nshɛŋ shiŋshi.
Banchɛndaa ba Nyo kɛ bo toŋe chisoŋ chi chinɛh
Banchɛndaa ba Nyo ba bvusooshwi ba gɛ̀ kɛme chisoŋ chi bvusooshwi chiɛɛ mo bo seesɛ ye ki bo tôŋ chisoŋ chiyu.

Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù fwe toŋ che soŋ, abe bɛ ŋgu ba fiiŋsɛ bɛ kilɛmɛ kesɛ yi nshɛŋ le. Kimbe ki nshɛŋ kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe bitɛde fie, kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe bitɛde bi bite fie, agaaŋ a le ŋgee achii fie tɛ.

Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù kiŋgane kinfɛɛ toŋ che soŋ, bo noŋ fiɛɛ fimi ŋgu bɛde yu, fi nyume njɛ mbegɛ wù baaŋ. Fi gwe a joo yì baaŋ le. Kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe bitɛde bi joo yì baaŋ ja bi tu kilɛmɛ.
Kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bitɛde bi mwɛɛ mu wuŋe mù le a joo yì baaŋ le kweeyɛ. Kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe bitɛde bi mutima mu a joo saayɛ.
Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù kiŋgane kintɛde toŋ che soŋ, joŋ yimi yì baaŋ ja fɛwe yi bɛde njɛ kin'yesɛ, yi gwe yi baŋɛ kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bitɛde bi jóo yì bohge bɛ manjuu mà jóo to yi bude mo le.

Jee chi joŋ yiyu nyu lɛ Nlujɛ. No yi gwe noo, kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe bitɛde bi jóo tu bi luji. Bamii ba duude kweeyɛ nje jóo yiyu yì bo gɛ̀ muu, nje joŋ yiyu gɛ̀ ge wa jóo yiyu tu yi luji lo.

Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù kiŋgane kinɛh toŋ che soŋ, fiɛɛ fimi bwɛɛdɛ juu kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe bitɛde bɛ kimbe kimimia ki kwii antɛnɛɛ a bitɛde. Fi bwɛɛdɛ tɛ jóŋ kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bì bitɛde. Bimbe biboo kimimia kimimia tu ki jiime. N'yulɛ faŋ ki wu ka wu nyûme yu a kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe bì bitɛde kì fɛnshɛ le mo kì antaŋ le.

Ndoo n'jiŋɛ, nja n'yu nfa ja wu jaŋɛ fɛwɛɛwe no wu gɛ̀ fuune antɛnɛɛ a kibvulɛ wu duu lɛ, “Ŋgɛ lɛɛ, ŋgɛ lɛɛ, ŋgɛ lé wu gê wu nyûme fɛ bamii ba le yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le sege ba toŋ chisoŋ chì shɛshi chì banchɛndaa ba batɛde le wa ki bo tôŋ.”
